title: Ranged figures stay back
lines: In The Little Raid, figures that reached 3 hexes now reach 4 (the Reed Heron 5), so from your back row they hit the enemy's front row without walking up. Each card says the row a figure reaches from; the Apothecary Gnome reaches 2, from the second row.
A figure no longer walks past an enemy it can hit, and one that has to walk stops on the hex furthest from other enemies. Ranged and Caster figures that reach 4 or 5 have 8% less health.
